focus: D4 Maintainability - duplicated declarations and load cost of the next change

findingDetails.title: A user flow is never held to the 12-connector budget the shared rule states
findingDetails.evidence: BUDGET sets USER_FLOW: (9, None); references/flow-mode.md:298 states the shared 12-connector budget applies unless the type sets its own.
findingDetails.recommendation: Set the user-flow budget to (9, 12), or record the intended cap in references/types/user-flow.md:66.
findingDetails.scopeProof: flowchart.py:47 is the only budget table; flowchart.py:236-240 the only comparison.

findingDetails.title: The first declared node is excused from the way-in rule whatever its shape
findingDetails.evidence: first_id is steps[0].id (flowchart.py:233) and exempts any shape at flowchart.py:155.
findingDetails.recommendation: Exempt a start only when its shape is a stadium.
findingDetails.scopeProof: flowchart.py:233 sets first_id and flowchart.py:155 is its only consumer.

findingDetails.title: An arrow table in the sequence check is defined and never read
findingDetails.evidence: ARROWS is defined and never read; the arrow decision uses REFUSED_ARROWS at sequence.py:83.
findingDetails.recommendation: Delete the table or use it where an arrow is classified.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grepped the packet for ARROWS; no reader, no importer.

findingDetails.title: The state check accepts TD while its message and type reference allow LR or TB
findingDetails.evidence: DIRECTIONS = {LR, TB, TD} while state.py:46 and references/types/state.md:60 say LR or TB.
findingDetails.recommendation: Drop TD or fold it into TB, and align state.py:46 with the type reference.
findingDetails.scopeProof: state.py:21 and state.py:45-46 are the whole direction rule for the state profile.

findingDetails.title: The contract never says source material is data rather than instructions, while six diagnostics echo a raw model line back
findingDetails.evidence: no untrusted-source rule in SKILL.md or flow-mode.md, while six diagnostics echo the offending statement unquoted.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a source-material-is-data rule and quote the text at the echo sites.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grepped for untrusted/inject/ignore-previous; enumerated every f-string embedding model text.

findingDetails.title: --self-test can report a full pass while a shipped template or example was dropped from the proof
findingDetails.evidence: a shipped model with no mermaid fence is skipped (flow_check.py:229-230) and an absent mirror prints SKIP without counting.
findingDetails.recommendation: Fail, or state in the summary, when a packet-owned shipped model carries no block.
findingDetails.scopeProof: flow_check.py:174-179 builds the set by glob; flow_check.py:225-233 holds the only continue branches.

findingDetails.title: references/flow-mode.md declares itself ON-DEMAND while the contract loads it on every Flow route
findingDetails.evidence: flow-mode.md:20 says ON-DEMAND while SKILL.md:64 puts the same file in the CONDITIONAL row on every Flow route.
findingDetails.recommendation: Make the header CONDITIONAL and settle one spelling of the level token.
findingDetails.scopeProof: read the loading-condition header of all twelve reference files and both asset files.

findingDetails.title: The contract says the vendored extractor is kept in step through vendor.json but never says where that manifest lives
findingDetails.evidence: the manifest is at AI Systems/Product Owner/vendor.json, README.md:62 names ../scripts/vendor-sync.py instead, and the control itself holds: the copy hashes to 4562fe4d0aab108e179a5f522c1b857a28b66226ad8ff5cec6dfb9b40059756d, the recorded digest.
findingDetails.recommendation: Name the manifest path in SKILL.md:156 and README.md:62.
findingDetails.scopeProof: ls of scripts/vendored/ shows mermaid_extract.py alone; the manifest sits at the hub root.

findingDetails.title: The packet's file map is written twice and the two copies already disagree
findingDetails.evidence: SKILL.md:141-157 and README.md:49-63 describe the same packet; they diverge on the vendored line (SKILL.md:156 vendor.json against README.md:62 ../scripts/vendor-sync.py) and on the check line (SKILL.md:154 against README.md:60).
findingDetails.recommendation: Have README.md link to SKILL.md Section 3 instead of restating the tree.
findingDetails.scopeProof: read both maps in full and diffed them line by line; both carry all eight top-level entries.

findingDetails.title: The seven-type vocabulary is declared twice with nothing asserting that the two agree
findingDetails.evidence: DIAGRAM_TYPES at SKILL.md:77 and NAMES at flow_check.py:70-71 hold the same seven names, and no fixture or assertion compares them; references/types/ and assets/examples/ are keyed to the same list with no assertion.
findingDetails.recommendation: Derive the dispatch key set from one source, or assert the two lists agree in --self-test.
findingDetails.scopeProof: SKILL.md:77 is the only type tuple; flow_check.py:63-71 are the dispatch keys; seven references and seven examples, one per name; no assertion over the list exists.

findingDetails.title: The largest reference is loaded on every Flow route, against the packet's own tiered-loading design
findingDetails.evidence: references/flow-mode.md is 441 lines in nine sections and loads on every Flow route, while hybrid-workflow.md (216 lines) loads only when the gate names an extension and the rubric and style guide load only before the gate; Sections 6 to 8 apply only after the model passes.
findingDetails.recommendation: Split Sections 6 to 8 into an ON_DEMAND reference, as hybrid-workflow.md was split.
findingDetails.scopeProof: counted the nine headings and 441 lines of flow-mode.md against rubric 124, style-guide 162 and hybrid-workflow 216 lines, and read the tiers at SKILL.md:61-65.

spec_code.notes: seven references and seven examples, one per type, all present; finding 2 is about the missing assertion

checklist_evidence.notes: fixtures.py holds 9 good models and 106 planted defects, broader than the one-defect-per-rule claim

skill_agent.notes: hybrid-workflow.md:19 is the worked example of the tiered split the packet states

agent_cross_runtime.notes: no agent file in the packet

playbook_capability.notes: 52 scenario files for 43 ids; the index does not explain the nine files without an id

noveltyJustification: Three first-record P2 findings, each naming a different duplication or load decision. Weighted new 3 against weighted total 15.
